headline: Your backlog.
intro: Extend your development team with programmers who work inside your stack, your repository, and your review process. Turn well-scoped tickets into tested changes your technical lead can trust.
serviceIntro: Add capacity where your product needs it: frontend, APIs, platforms, data, quality assurance, and maintenance. Every engagement starts with the stack, acceptance checks, and an accountable reviewer.
storyTitle: Built to fit your engineering rhythm.
story: You should not have to surrender control to get more done. Work moves through your existing branches, pull requests, staging environments, and release decisions.
pillars: Show us the repository conventions, affected module, expected behavior, and a useful example of accepted work.
Small pull requests, reproducible checks, and clear implementation notes give your reviewer the context to make decisions.
Your technical owner controls architecture, sensitive access, merges, and releases. The team prepares the change and its evidence.
footer: Programming support for product teams that value clear scope, maintainable code, and client-controlled releases.
